traits.name: Armor-Rending Bite
traits.text: ⬺ The hive mother makes a mandibles Strike; if the Strike hits, the target's armor takes the damage and the acid damage bypasses the armor's Hardness.

traits.name: Frenzy Pheromone
traits.text: ⬺ The hive mother unleashes a pheromone that causes all other ankhravs within a 100-foot emanation to become quickened 1 until the start of the hive mother's next turn, and they can use the extra action only for Burrow, Stride, or Strike actions. The hive mother can't unleash the pheromone again for 1d4 (1d4) rounds.

traits.name: Spray Acid
traits.text: ⬺ (acid); The hive mother spews acid in a 60-foot cone, dealing 8d6 (8d6) acid damage and 1d6 (1d6) persistent acid damage (DC 26 basic Reflex save). It can't spew acid again for 1d4 (1d4) rounds.

actions.name: Ranged
actions.text: ⬻ acid spit +17 (acid, range 30 feet); Damage 5d6 (5d6) acid
